say:2:1341120001:1.source_cn: 咦，柳博米尔？！你怎么会跑到这里来？

say:3:1341120002:1.text: For my final farewell to Yolena.

say:4:1341120003:1.source_cn: 我明白了，你也一定很难过吧。

say:5:1341120004:1.text: I wouldn't say that. I just feel a bit emotional, thinking she was the last descendant of my family.
say:5:1341120004:1.source_cn: 不，谈不上难过。我只是想到她是瓦勒沙家最后一个继承人，...

say:6:1341120005:1.text: I won't be attending her funeral, but I'll still offer her a bouquet of everblooms. They don't quite suit her, but they are fitting for death.
say:6:1341120005:1.source_cn: 虽然我并不会去参加她的葬礼，不过我依旧会为她献上一束花...

choice_prompt:7:1341120005.text: I won't be attending her funeral, but I'll still offer her a bouquet of everblooms. They don't quite suit her, but they are fitting for death.

say:8:1341120006:1.text: There are none left in the duchy, but I'm not sure about other places. Maybe some of the Valesas have moved away.
say:8:1341120006:1.source_cn: 至少公国内没有了。至于其他地方，我不知道。或许有些瓦勒...

say:9:1341120007:1.text: When the Lightbearer Empire was established after the first Divine War, General Jesford Valesa was granted the title of Archduke by the Emperor for his military achievements, with Whiteridge as his fief.
say:9:1341120007:1.source_cn: 第一次神魔大战之后，耀光帝国建立。杰斯瓦夫·瓦勒沙将军...

say:10:1341120008:1.text: Since then, the Valesa family has been the ruler of Whiteridge until... the recent death of Sigmund Valesa.
say:10:1341120008:1.source_cn: 从这位伟大的祖先开始，瓦勒沙家族一直是白山公国的统治者...

choice_prompt:11:1341120008.text: Since then, the Valesa family has been the ruler of Whiteridge until... the recent death of Sigmund Valesa.
choice_prompt:11:1341120008.source_cn: 从这位伟大的祖先开始，瓦勒沙家族一直是白山公国的统治者，直到不久前……齐格蒙德·瓦勒沙死亡为止。

say:12:1341120009:1.text: No need. I'm just stating the facts.
say:12:1341120009:1.source_cn: 请不必道歉。我只是在陈述事实而已。

say:13:1341120011:1.text: Even if Sigmund were still alive, he wouldn't be fit to rule this land anymore after selling his soul to the Hypogeans and becoming their puppet.
say:13:1341120011:1.source_cn: 实际上，就算齐格蒙德活着，将灵魂出卖给恶魔、自愿成为恶...

say:14:1341120012:1.text: Our ancestors sacrificed themselves to overcome the Hypogeans, yet their descendants sold themselves to the Hypogeans... How ironic.
say:14:1341120012:1.source_cn: 这个爵位、这个公国——这里的一切都是因为对抗恶魔而来。...

say:15:1341120013:1.text: Since the first Divine War, the Valesas have faced constant retaliation from the Hypogeans. Many have been massacred, including my younger brother's family.
say:15:1341120013:1.source_cn: 从第一次神魔大战后，瓦勒沙家族就一直遭受零散出现的恶魔...

say:17:1341120015:1.text: Yes, he was born after my death and inherited the Earl of Silversparrow title from my father. All of his descendants were killed in the Second Divine War twenty years ago.
say:17:1341120015:1.source_cn: 嗯，我父母在我过世之后生的孩子，他继承了我父亲银雀伯爵...

say:18:1341120016:1.text: Like the Radinovs, they died honorably during the war... None of them begged for mercy, even in the final moments.
say:18:1341120016:1.source_cn: 和拉季诺夫家的人一样，他们是战死的……直到死，也没有一...

say:19:1341120017:1.text: The Valesas are resilient and courageous. Now that the last member of the family has passed away, it's only right for me to mourn for her and my family.
say:19:1341120017:1.source_cn: 瓦勒沙家族是坚韧、勇敢的家族。家族的最后一个人离开的时...

say:20:1341120018:1.text: Centuries later, will the Valesas become a legend in history or be forgotten? When the time comes, I'll tell this tale again. It'll surely be fun.
say:20:1341120018:1.source_cn: 几百上千年之后，瓦勒沙家族是会成为传说，还是被人们遗忘...

choice:11:1:2.text: You're not blaming us, are you?
